segments.text: Phil is terrified of the narrow crawl space under the house, but he does not want Luke to know. When Luke’s remote-control car gets stuck inside and Luke goes after it, Phil has to face his fear and crawl in to help him.

segments.text: He tries to act brave, even after finding what he thinks are human bones. The “danger” turns out to be harmless, but Phil still proves that he can move forward when Luke needs him.

segments.text: Claire takes Haley to her driving test. She worries that Haley will fail, but Haley passes. Claire also encourages Alex to attend a school dance. Alex is afraid of looking awkward, and Claire tells her that avoiding every embarrassing experience is not the same as being safe.

segments.text: Meanwhile, Mitchell and Cameron worry that Lily’s first word will be “Mommy,” because there is no mother in their home. When they hear a voice repeatedly saying something that sounds like the word, they become anxious about what it means.

segments.text: They eventually discover that the sound comes from a toy. Their pediatrician reminds them that they do not need to treat every normal event as a judgment on their family.

segments.text: Jay makes fun of Manny for being afraid of a roller coaster. Gloria knows that Jay is frightened too, so she tricks both of them into going on the ride. They pretend to be calm until the roller coaster starts, and then they panic together.

segments.text: Overall, the episode suggests that courage does not mean having no fear. It means doing what is necessary even when you are frightened and do not look especially heroic.
